name: com.infobip.webrtc.ui.internal.service.DefaultInfobipRtcUiFirebaseService
description: When Firebase delivers an Infobip RTC call message or refreshes a push token, this service handles the call or updates the device registration; other messages can be passed to Infobip Mobile Messaging.
disableEffect: Incoming RTC calls may not appear, and refreshed push tokens may not be registered.
